_doc: scripts/hook_bench.py reads hooks from .claude/settings.json and ~/.claude/settings.json. Hooks whose command contains a 'skip' substring are observability or setup, not behaviour; 'live_state' hooks depend on git or files as they are now, so replaying old events through them means nothing; 'names' labels inline commands by a substring of their text. PostToolUse hooks run only if listed in 'post_tool_replay': list a hook there only after reading it and confirming it reads stdin and writes stdout, nothing else (most PostToolUse hooks stage, index or sync).

live_state.session-end-check.sh: reads the repo's current CHANGELOG/HANDOFF state
live_state.pr-gate-guard.sh: reads the last first-run gate report
live_state.git add -u: stages files in the live checkout
